name: comprehension-guard
description: Blocks large pastes, inline AI insertions, and AI coding-agent edits behind a quick comprehension check, so you understand code before it lands in your file.

commands.title: Comprehension Guard: Bypass Next Insertion (deadline escape hatch)
Comprehension Guard: Install AI Agent Hooks

comprehensionGuard.enabled.description: Enable the comprehension check on large pastes and inline insertions.

comprehensionGuard.charThreshold.description: Minimum number of characters in a single paste, inline insertion, or AI-agent edit before the comprehension check is triggered.

comprehensionGuard.minAnswerLength.description: Minimum length of an explanation (in characters) required to pass the comprehension check.

comprehensionGuard.provider.description: LLM provider for question generation and grading. ollama is local and does not need an API key.

comprehensionGuard.model.description: Model id. Leave empty to use a sensible mid-tier default for the provider. Do not use nano/mini tiers for grading.

comprehensionGuard.gradingMode.description: Grading mode: free-text LLM-as-judge or deterministic multiple-choice.

comprehensionGuard.nonCriticalPassFracti.description: Fraction of non-critical criteria that must pass (all critical criteria must always pass).

comprehensionGuard.maxFollowups.description: Maximum number of follow-up questions before a final decision.
